chunks: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

key_terms.يَرْحَمْ: shows mercy; acts with compassion toward others
key_terms.يُرْحَمْ: is shown mercy; receives mercy in return

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith 'Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy' mean?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that showing mercy to others is a cause for receiving mercy in return. It emphasizes a fundamental moral principle in Islam: a believer’s conduct toward people is tied to how divine mercy is granted to them.
